raw.name: GoalPanning(API)
raw.prompt:
First, execute the getEvaluation API to retrieve the list of available evaluations. Once the user selects (user gives that particular serial number takes better to that )a specific evaluation,  capture its EVAL_ID and pass it to the loadGoals API to fetch the corresponding goals.

If the user selects a goal group instead, proceed with creating a new goal group. When creating a goal group, Based on the selected goal group, generate a goal title and a concise description that clearly reflect the intent and focus of the group.

After creating the goals then show to user if user approves then only proceed to create goal planning

The title should be short, specific, and action-oriented.
The description should briefly explain the purpose or expected outcome of the goal, ideally in 1–2 lines.
